∀ {α : Type u} {β : α → Type v} (k : α) (v : β k)
  (motive :
    Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β →

  motive Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v} Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}
      (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} 1 k v Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}
        Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}) →
    (∀ (size : Nat) (k_1 : α) (v_1 : β k_1),
        motive
          (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} size k_1 v_1 Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}
            Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v})
          Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}
          (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} 2 k v

              Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v})
            Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v})) →
      (∀ (size : Nat) (lk : α) (lv : β lk) (size_1 : Nat) (lrk : α) (lrv : β lrk)
          (l r : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β),
          motive

              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} size_1 lrk lrv l r))
            Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}
            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} 3 lrk lrv
              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} 1 lk lv Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}
                Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v})
              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} 1 k v Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}
                Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}))) →
        (∀ (size : Nat) (lk : α) (lv : β lk) (size_1 : Nat) (k_1 : α) (v_1 : β k_1)
            (l r : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β),
            motive
              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} size lk lv
                (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} size_1 k_1 v_1 l r) Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v})
              Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}
              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} 3 lk lv
                (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} size_1 k_1 v_1 l r)
                (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} 1 k v Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}

          (∀ (ls : Nat) (lk : α) (lv : β lk) (size : Nat) (k_1 : α) (v_1 : β k_1)
              (l r : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β) (lrs : Nat) (k_2 : α) (v_2 : β k_2)
              (l_1 r_1 : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β),
              motive
                (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv
                  (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} size k_1 v_1 l r)
                  (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} lrs k_2 v_2 l_1 r_1))
                Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}
                (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 ls) lk lv
                  (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} size k_1 v_1 l r)
                  (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 lrs) k v
                    (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} lrs k_2 v_2 l_1 r_1)
                    Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v}))) →
            (∀ (ls : Nat) (lk : α) (lv : β lk) (ll lr : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β),
                motive Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v} (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv ll lr)
                  (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 ls) k v

                  (lv_1 : β lk_1),
                  GT.gt.{0} ls_1 (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Std.DTreeMap.Internal.delta ls) →

                      LT.lt.{0} lrs (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Std.DTreeMap.Internal.ratio lls) →
                        motive
                          (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls_1 lk_1 lv_1
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} lls k_1 v_1 l r)
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} lrs lrk lrv lrl lrr))
                          (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv ll lr)
                          (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 ls_1) ls)
                            lk_1 lv_1 (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} lls k_1 v_1 l r)
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v}
                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 ls) lrs) k v
                              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} lrs lrk lrv lrl lrr)
                              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv ll lr)))) →
                (∀ (ls : Nat) (lk : α) (lv : β lk) (ll lr : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β) (ls_1 : Nat)
                    (lk_1 : α) (lv_1 : β lk_1),
                    GT.gt.{0} ls_1 (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Std.DTreeMap.Internal.delta ls) →
                      ∀ (lls : Nat) (k_1 : α) (v_1 : β k_1) (l r : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β) (lrs : Nat)
                        (lrk : α) (lrv : β lrk) (lrl lrr : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β),
                        Not (LT.lt.{0} lrs (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Std.DTreeMap.Internal.ratio lls)) →
                          motive
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls_1 lk_1 lv_1
                              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} lls k_1 v_1 l r)
                              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} lrs lrk lrv lrl lrr))
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv ll lr)
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v}
                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 ls_1) ls) lrk lrv
                              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v}
                                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 lls)
                                  (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.size.{u, v} lrl))
                                lk_1 lv_1 (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} lls k_1 v_1 l r) lrl)
                              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v}
                                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 ls)
                                  (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.size.{u, v} lrr))
                                k v lrr (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv ll lr)))) →
                  (∀ (ls : Nat) (lk : α) (lv : β lk) (ll lr : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β) (ls_1 : Nat)
                      (lk_1 : α) (lv_1 : β lk_1),
                      GT.gt.{0} ls_1 (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Std.DTreeMap.Internal.delta ls) →
                        ∀ (size : Nat) (k : α) (v : β k) (l r : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β),
                          motive
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls_1 lk_1 lv_1
                              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} size k v l r)
                              Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v})
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv ll lr)
                            (panicWithPosWithDecl.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} "Std.Data.DTreeMap.Internal.Balancing"
                              "Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balanceL!" 178 35 "balanceL! input was not balanced")) →
                    (∀ (ls : Nat) (lk : α) (lv : β lk) (ll lr : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β) (ls_1 : Nat)
                        (lk_1 : α) (lv_1 : β lk_1) (lr_1 : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β),
                        GT.gt.{0} ls_1 (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Std.DTreeMap.Internal.delta ls) →
                          motive
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls_1 lk_1 lv_1
                              Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf.{u, v} lr_1)
                            (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv ll lr)
                            (panicWithPosWithDecl.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} "Std.Data.DTreeMap.Internal.Balancing"
                              "Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balanceL!" 179 21 "balanceL! input was not balanced")) →
                      (∀ (ls : Nat) (lk : α) (lv : β lk) (ll lr : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β) (ls_1 : Nat)
                          (lk_1 : α) (lv_1 : β lk_1) (ll_1 lr_1 : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β),
                          Not (GT.gt.{0} ls_1 (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Std.DTreeMap.Internal.delta ls)) →
                            motive (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls_1 lk_1 lv_1 ll_1 lr_1)
                              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv ll lr)
                              (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v}
                                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 ls_1) ls) k v
                                (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls_1 lk_1 lv_1 ll_1 lr_1)
                                (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner.{u, v} ls lk lv ll lr))) →
                        ∀ (l r : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β),
                          motive l r (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balanceL!.{u, v} k v l r)
